scenes.title: Manchester Collaborative Robot Inspection Bay
scenes.reference_notes: Official laboratory page and its installed apparatus photograph reviewed. Black serial manipulator with white joint bands and white finger gripper. Table-edge mounting bracket with visible yellow cable. Window-side perimeter counters, turquoise under-bench storage and rear equipment case.
observed_cues: Black serial manipulator with white joint bands and white finger gripper.
Table-edge mounting bracket with visible yellow cable.
Window-side perimeter counters, turquoise under-bench storage and rear equipment case.

equipment.role: Use collision-aware joint motion to place the empty fixed hand 100 mm above the retained block, point the tool axis downward and return to measured start.
equipment.evidence: Original geometry from inspected official photo; dimensions and hidden mechanics estimated

task.name: Manchester empty-tool inspection and return
task.description: Use collision-aware joint motion to place the empty fixed hand 100 mm above the retained block, point the tool axis downward and return to measured start.
task.observable: Measured tool position, direction, clearance at every physics step and return error; the retained block stays fixed and no grasp or scientific measurement is claimed.

layout_rationale: Black serial manipulator with white joint bands and white finger gripper.
Table-edge mounting bracket with visible yellow cable.
Window-side perimeter counters, turquoise under-bench storage and rear equipment case.
A local BSD-3-Clause Kinova Gen3 model substitutes for the photographed Kinova/Quanser arm; this is not the same-model CAD reconstruction.
The original three-finger appearance tool is fixed open and does not implement grasping. The inert target remains clamped to its independent table fixture.

All seven controls report offsets from the imported Gen3 home. Source joint 2/4/6 hard ranges are retained; source-unlimited axes use a finite +/-pi offset window. Collisions restrict feasible configurations and require motion planning; this is not an OEM performance evaluation.
The local robot license remains at Hooke/model/robot_menagerie/kinova_gen3/LICENSE; no reference photograph is redistributed.

The photographed cable destination is outside the frame; the attached parking bracket and rigid curved service route are authored. Retaining pads close the visible jaw gaps, without a clamp-force or cable-flexibility model.
limitations: Reference-informed prototype; not surveyed, scientifically validated, institution-approved or endorsed.
Only original geometry; reference photographs are not redistributed.
Dimensions, unobserved mechanics and travel are authored estimates.
MuJoCo CPU articulation does not establish Isaac runtime verification.
Official promotional lab photograph; people obscure left-hand bench and room boundaries are unknown. No exact robot OEM CAD, calibration or control-performance match is claimed.
